import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def chk(req, ev, pol, expected):
    before = copy.deepcopy((req, ev, pol))
    got = evaluate(req, ev, pol)
    assert got == expected, (got, expected)
    assert (req, ev, pol) == before

# Current fixtures and report.
requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json'))
policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
report=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert report == [evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
# Missing conditions are sorted and stop evidence use.
chk({'claim':'c','conditions':{}}, [], {'required_conditions':['z','a']}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']})
# Verification, withdrawal, and exact required-condition matching.
chk({'claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1}}, [
 {'source':'wrong','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'k':1},'verified':True},
 {'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'k':1},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},
 {'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'k':1}},
 {'source':'mismatch','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'k':2},'verified':True}],
 {'required_conditions':['k'],'require_verified':True}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
# Canonical object agreement, sorted/deduplicated sources, and supersession.
chk({'claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1}}, [
 {'source':'old','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'k':1}},
 {'source':'b','claim':'c','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'conditions':{'k':1},'supersedes':['old']},
 {'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'x':1,'y':2},'conditions':{'k':1}},
 {'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'conditions':{'k':1}}],
 {'required_conditions':['k']}, {'status':'supported','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]})
# Counts do not decide disagreement.
chk({'claim':'c','conditions':{}}, [
 {'source':'a','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{}},
 {'source':'b','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{}},
 {'source':'c','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{}}],
 {'required_conditions':[]}, {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b','c'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
# Only literal Boolean false is unsupported; absent value remains supported null.
chk({'claim':'c','conditions':{}}, [{'source':'f','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{}}], {'required_conditions':[]}, {'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]})
chk({'claim':'c','conditions':{}}, [{'source':'n','claim':'c','conditions':{}}], {'required_conditions':[]}, {'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['n'],'unknowns':[]})
print('all checks passed')
